name: Client Effects & Weather
author: Kelly D Ripper and contributors
description:
Client-side weather, cockpit, ocean, audio, lighting and battlefield effects. Open FX on the map MFD. Weather controls are single-player only.

Incompatible with standalone Boscali Summer and KROP. Their effects are already integrated into this pack. Disable their standalone plugins before enabling this pack; keep your existing configuration files.

NOAtmoFX is a compatible optional bolt-on, downloaded separately.
